chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whenever a tablecloth is spread and someone whose name is Ahmad or Muhammad sits upon it, that house is purified twice each day.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit for a house when someone named Ahmad or Muhammad is present at a meal?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Shaykh al-Saduq records the Prophet’s promise that the presence of one named Ahmad or Muhammad at a meal sanctifies the dwelling, reflecting the Shia belief in the spiritual efficacy of the Prophet's names. This purification is understood not merely as physical cleanliness but as a divine blessing (*barakah*) that elevates the status of the home through the intercession and presence of the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-31 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “
Whenever there is a tablecloth spread and there is someone named Muhammad or Ahmad sitting around it, the house will be purified twice each day.”
